name: Mint Mobile
notes: Researched from public mintmobile.com Help Center and plan pages only (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in). Mint is prepaid: plans are bought up front for 3, 6 or 12 months and renewed in the app or at mintmobile.com/login (the public Log In page asks for Phone Number and Password). Auto Renewal charges the card on file at renewal; changes or turning it off must be made at least 24 hours before the renewal date. If a renewal fails service stops until a payment is made (no grace or payment plan documented, so payment_arrangement not_applicable, inferred). Payments are cards (payment method + Mint wallet credit); no bank drafts documented, so billing.methods [card]. No paper bills (paperless not_applicable, inferred), no guest payment (guest_pay not_applicable, inferred), no future-dated payments (scheduled_payment not_applicable, inferred). Service cannot be paused; there is no online cancel button documented: customers turn off Auto Renewal and let the plan expire, and new plans have a 7-day money-back guarantee through Customer Care (cancel_service unsupported online, inferred). Optional two-factor authentication uses an authenticator app (TOTP), which the engine cannot model; auth.mfa none. Plan prices are the published 12-month plan monthly equivalents (paid up front: $180/$240/$300/$360); intro 3-month and 6-month offers are left out. GAP: multi-month up-front plan prices (annual plan prices) cannot be modelled; engine shows them as monthly.

guest_pay.note: Plans are renewed after logging in to your account online or in the Mint Mobile app.

autopay.note: Auto Renewal charges the card on file when your plan is up for renewal. Make plan changes or turn it off at least 24 hours before your renewal date.

autopay_cancel.note: Toggle Auto Renewal off under Payment at least 24 hours before your renewal date. Without a manual renewal your plan will go into suspension when it expires.

scheduled_payment.note: Renewal payments are charged when you make them; you can renew any time up until your plan period ends.

paperless.note: Mint Mobile does not mail bills; receipts arrive by email and your transaction history is in your account and the app.

payment_arrangement.note: Mint Mobile does not offer payment plans; if a renewal payment fails, service stops until you make a payment.

cancel_service.note: To stop service, turn off Auto Renewal and let your plan expire. New plans can be refunded within 7 days of activation through Customer Care at 800-683-7392 (dial 611 from your Mint phone).

change_plan.note: More data can start now (pay the difference) or at your next plan; less data and a different plan length start with your next plan.

notes: A Recovery Fee and state and local telecom taxes are listed separately at checkout; they vary by ZIP code.

help.title: How do I set up and manage auto renewal?
paragraphs: Auto Renewal renews your Mint plan automatically using the card you bought it with, so your service is not interrupted. Mint reminds you by text and email 30 days before your renewal date, and you can see the date in the app.

You can turn it on at checkout, during activation in the app, or later in the app or your online account under Payment. Any plan change, payment method update or Auto Renewal cancellation must be made at least 24 hours before the scheduled renewal.
If Auto Renewal is off and you do not renew by hand before the plan ends, the account goes into suspension.
steps: Log in to your Mint Mobile account.
Open My Account from the menu.
Under Payment, make sure a payment method is saved.

help.title: How do I renew my plan?
paragraphs: Renew in the Mint Mobile app or after logging in at mintmobile.com. Check that a card is on file under Payment Method, open Manage Plan (My Plan in the app), pick the plan to renew, then pay or turn on Auto Renewal.

Renew before your plan period ends to avoid a pause in service. If your Mint wallet holds enough credit the plan renews from it. If a payment fails Mint sends a text, and service stays off until you pay.

help.title: Mint plans and prices
paragraphs: Mint plans are paid up front for 3, 6 or 12 months. On a 12-month plan the monthly equivalents are $15 (6GB), $20 (17GB), $25 (23GB) and $30 (Unlimited), paid as $180, $240, $300 or $360 up front. New-customer offers apply to the first plan only; renewals are charged at the regular price for the plan length you choose.
Taxes and a Recovery Fee are added at checkout. You can add data mid-plan by paying the difference; smaller plans and a different length start with your next plan, and service cannot be paused.

help.title: What is my Mint Mobile wallet?
paragraphs: The Mint wallet stores credit for add-ons such as extra data, Minternational passes, phone protection and international calls, and can cover a plan renewal. Add $5, $10 or $20 at a time in the app or online; the balance does not expire.

extra.intent: Using Mint Mobile's help pages, find how far ahead of the renewal date Auto Renewal must be turned off or changed. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Changes or turning off Auto Renewal must be done at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

extra.intent: Find the phone number for Mint Mobile customer care. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: Call 800-683-7392 or dial 611 from a Mint phone.

extra.intent: Find out whether a Mint Mobile customer can pause service. Answer yes or no and do not change anything.

solution.text: No - Mint Mobile service cannot be paused; the plan stays active for its cycle.
